verdict.rationale: The Agent Skills spec requires each SKILL.md to be YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown, with optional bundled scripts, references and templates as ordinary files. The CLI installs these plain files into readable per-agent directories (project-committed or global), symlinked to a canonical copy across 75+ supported agents. It also scaffolds new SKILL.md templates and installs directly from a SKILL.md URL, and the spec promises build-once, use-anywhere reuse across skills-compatible agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a skill copied by hand works unchanged in a different harness.
